cut_the_tubing — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed cut and deburred length of rigid tubing, before any sleeve or nut is installed visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Tubing remains continuous and unsevered from the main stock length at the cut point.
2. Cut end exhibits a visibly pinched flat or oval cross-section.
3. Bore at the cut end displays an inward-projecting raised burr ring.
4. Outside edge of the cut end displays a prominent raised curled lip.
5. Tube wall adjacent to the cut displays deep score grooves and gouges.
6. Tube end features a sleeve and B-nut installed over the cut section.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Cut end is crushed flat or collapsed out of round.
8. The finished work shows this defect: Tube shows a kink, wrinkle or flattened section along its length.
9. The finished work shows this defect: Cut end carries a torn, jagged tab of partially severed metal.
10. The finished work shows this defect: Bore of the tube contains loose metal chips or shavings.
11. The finished work shows this defect: Deep spiral or circumferential cuts scar the tube wall away from the cut.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

negative.criterion:
preset_the_sleeve — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed flareless tube connection with the sleeve preset, tube nut tightened onto the fitting in a vise visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Tube nut is backed off from the fitting body, leaving visible exposed threads and a gap between nut and fitting body.
2. Fitting is clamped at an angle in the vise, with the tube visibly canted out of line.
3. Tube enters the nut at a sharp angle, showing a distinct bend or cocking where it meets the joint.
4. Tube end is cut diagonally to its axis where visible, with coarse ragged burrs and metal chips clinging to the rim.
5. The finished work shows this defect: Tube is visibly collapsed, crushed or necked down at the nut.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Tube end is bare against the fitting with no nut installed.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Nut is cracked, split, or its threads are visibly stripped.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

negative.criterion:
inspect_the_preset_connection — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed preset flareless tube end with its sleeve and B-nut, disconnected from the fitting for inspection visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Tube assembly remains threaded onto the fitting, with the fitting body fully engaged inside the B-nut
2. Sleeve is installed backward on the tube end with its cutting edge facing toward the B-nut
3. Tube end is recessed flush with or behind the end face of the sleeve pilot
4. A rule, scale, or caliper in frame spans across the B-nut hex flats rather than from the sleeve pilot face to tube end
5. Sleeve cutting edge bite mark forms a longitudinal line along the length of the tube rather than a ring impression
6. Tube end bore is crushed oval and pinched partially shut
7. The finished work shows this defect: Tube is split or cracked at the sleeve cutting edge.
8. The finished work shows this defect: Tube end is flush with or recessed behind the sleeve pilot.
9. The finished work shows this defect: Tube is crushed flat or closed at the sleeve cut.
10. The finished work shows this defect: Tube end is bare, with no sleeve between the B-nut and the tube end.
11. The finished work shows this defect: Tube is sharply kinked or bent immediately behind the sleeve.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
